feeds.title: Sweet Life in the Sandpit
feeds.description: Welcome to the Sweet Life in The Sandpit, a comprehensive site on great findings in the UAE, as well as a personal blog about my life. Find out what it's like to be an American girl who went local, and follow me on my journey here in the mystical sandpit of Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

feeds.title: Mother, Baby & Child
feeds.description: Mother Baby & Child is one of the oldest and most-loved parenting magazines in the UAE. As a monthly and online comprehensive resource catering to Moms, we provide information and advice on pregnancy and baby care, as well as the stages of development of children - along with everything that comes with the parenting territory.

feeds.title: British Mums Dubai Blog
feeds.description: British Mums Blog aims to provide British mums and the mums of British children living in the UAE, with an awesome community resource, which makes it super easy for them to find exactly what they're looking for. Explore Parenting advice, Lifestyle experiences, Insightful interviews and much more.

feeds.title: Mommy Local Spots
feeds.description: Thea is a Traveler and a Content Strategist living in UAE. At Mommy Local Spots she shares with you hidden gems, pocket-friendly activities, and nature escapades for visitors, foodies, and culture lovers. Dive a collection of articles listing Cool and Fun Things to do in Dubai.

feeds.title: Cuddles & Crumbs
feeds.description: The blog name 'Cuddles and Crumbs' represents the two main themes of my blog: family (cuddles) and food (crumbs). Over the years, the blog underwent several name changes from nappytales to mynappytales to finally settling on cuddlesandcrumbs. The blogger mom now believe that this name perfectly captures my passion and interests.

feeds.title: ThrifDee Dubai
feeds.description: ThrifDee Dubai is a proud Cockney Muslimah blogger, born and raised in London, England, and now residing in Dubai, UAE. As an ex-pat and mother of two, her goal is to be thrifty in Dubai and beyond. Join her on her journey for opinions on the latest happenings in the city, delicious recipes, lifestyle and parenting hacks, money-saving ideas, and reviews of the best places to go, known as 'ThrifDee' spots.

feeds.title: Dubai our Sandbox Blog
feeds.description: My name is Emily. I am the blogger (and maman of Luella and Josefin) behind this sunny little place on the web, called Dubai our Sandbox. I am on a mission to browse online, check magazines, talk to mums and girlfriends, be on the look out for kids 'goodies' to share with you. I hope to bring you useful and inspiring little finds for your family life in Dubai.

feeds.title: The Om Moms Club Blog
feeds.description: The Om Moms Club, based in Dubai, offers in-person classes and online access to their Om Demand Prenatal library (post-natal coming soon!). They are thrilled to have new members join their community and look forward to sharing all things Om and Mom on this journey.
